column1: # Consumer Credit Matters — Auto Loan ABS — First-Time Repossessions
# Source: SEC Form ABS-EE loan-level filings of the public auto-loan shelves
# Definition: Loans repossessed for the first time in the month over the loans at risk at its start; https://data.consumercreditmatters.com/abs/methodology.html#repossessions
# Note: Shelves whose loan-level flag does not track repossessions are not in the file.
# Columns: shelf = the shelf's ticker (ALL = every loan shelf pooled); shelf_name = the issuer; month = collection month
column2: YYYY-MM; universe = 'all' (every active deal) or 'seasoned' (deals at least 6 months old); repossessions = first-time repossessions in the month; at_risk = loans at risk at the start of the month; repo_rate = repossessions / at_risk; reversed_share = share of the month's repossessions later reinstated
